_comment: Film 63 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD/s, 2 samples each, 2026-11-24; sample 1 used unless noted). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f63/audio/sfx, not in the repo. Everything else from sfx-bibliothek (akzent: bloom, pages, rumble, brick, shimmer_rings, brass_click; atmo: hall).

candle.prompt: A single match is struck and lights a candle in a vast empty stone basilica at night: a soft scratch, a gentle flare and hiss, then a long quiet reverberation of the large stone space. Close and intimate, very clean, no music, no voices.

unlock.prompt: A heavy old metal mechanism is slowly unlocked and set down on a stone floor in a large cathedral: one deep soft metallic clunk, a short low resonance, then the long reverberation of the hall. Calm, weighty, no music, no voices.
